items.q1: What stops you from just taking my skin?
items.q1a: The same thing that stops us taking your money: we never hold both. Escrow releases to the seller only against a confirmed Steam trade record, and refunds to the buyer automatically if that record never appears. There is no state in the flow where keeping both is possible — it isn't a policy we could quietly change, it's the shape of the system.
